mapper.sql: a.appointment_id, a.appointment_no, a.patient_id, a.employee_id, a.clinic_id, a.appointment_time, a.expected_minutes, a.channel, a.status, a.created_time, a.cancel_reason, a.note, p.full_name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, e.full_name AS dentist_name, c.clinic_name, c.clinic_code

SELECT FROM appointment a JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} AND a.appointment_time >= #{from} ORDER BY a.appointment_time
